policy.rule: A release profile is blocked by every OPEN or REOPENED P0, P1, or P2 defect whose supportedProfiles includes that profile. Unsupported or deliberately disabled workflows must remain explicit; they are never silently omitted.

defects.summary: The generated IPC migration is incomplete; the closed legacy adapter still contains handwritten command contracts.
Several frontend workspaces and presentational components remain above the locked final architecture ceilings.
External flexible-pool work has no owner-approved compensation policy and is outside the supported release scope until PAY_POLICY_REQUIRED is resolved by owner canon.
